decisions.statement: A drop reaches the records kept beside this agent's page for the subagents under it.
A path is piped in as a line `at:` and that path, one path to a line.
The paths a drop takes away are piped in.
A drop piping nothing in is refused rather than taking every record away.
A drop saying `all: true` reaches every record that drop is over.
`all: true` said beside a path refuses the drop.
A path is read against the repository root.
A path naming no record the drop reaches refuses the drop.
A drop that refuses leaves every record where those records are.
A drop names each record that went.
A drop naming paths says how many records are still kept.
A drop leaving no record takes the file those records were in away.
A record whose line reads as no edit is reached by no path.
An agent keeping no record is said rather than refused.
An agent whose page is nowhere is refused rather than answered with nothing.
A word on the command line other than the help flag is refused.
A flag other than the help flag is refused as any other word is.
The help flag is answered with what a drop does and what a drop takes.

definition: the command taking away records a seat keeps without landing any of them
